decision_boundary: score complete executable candidate programs before any candidate rollout or active wrist inspection

task.terminal: all five parts seated, released, final acceptance checks pass and robot returns home

paired_rollout_randomization.pairing: same repeat draw for every candidate in one configuration; disjoint deterministic train/reference/twin/target namespaces

views.task: fixed global oblique camera covering robot, supplies and nest
views.top: fixed overhead camera covering supplies and nest

vision.excluded: wrist close-up, because it is unavailable before an explicit active-sensing motion
vision.augmentation: brightness, contrast, RGB sensor noise and depth noise; no left-right flips

training.target: empirical complete-program success rate over the three paired perturbation repeats
training.loss: binary cross entropy with soft empirical-rate targets, equal total weight per configuration
training.selection: lowest configuration-mean validation Brier; model-name tie break
training.classification_threshold: validation balanced accuracy, then ordinary accuracy, distance to 0.5 and lower threshold

held_out_metrics: Brier score to empirical success rate

system.comparison: actual Top-4 rollouts and actual all-12 rollouts; no cached outcomes

planner.source: current assistant as an explicit LLM proxy
planner.scope: proposes legal symbolic part orders; existing compilers and solvers instantiate executable parameters
